description: She wears an opaque dark blue floor length overdress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow length outer sleeves. Gold and brown woven borders decorate the straps, neckline, sleeves, waist, front panel and hem. Two round metal brooches sit on the upper bodice straps. Cream underdress sleeves and a cream central skirt panel show underneath. A burgundy fringed shoulder wrap rests around her forearms and hangs down both sides. Her hands rest together at the belt, brown shoes show beneath the hem, and her braided head is uncovered.
